h1: An SEO agency for New York firms competing in the hardest search market in the country
intro: 22 Signals is an SEO agency New York firms hire to win searches in Google and to show up in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Google AI Overview answers. We fix technical problems, build local search across the five boroughs, write answer-first pages checked for accuracy, and report every month on calls, forms and rankings, not vanity metrics.

sections.h: Why search in New York is different
p: In most US cities a law firm, clinic or agency competes with a few dozen rivals. Here it competes with hundreds, plus national brands, directories and publishers that all want the same page-one spots. Local results also split by neighborhood: someone in Astoria searching for a dentist sees a different map than someone in the Financial District, so a firm can lead in one borough and be invisible two subway stops away.

Search itself has also changed. More buyers now ask ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude for a recommendation, or read the AI Overview at the top of Google and never scroll. Being described correctly and consistently across the web now matters as much as ranking a page. That is the work of generative engine optimization (GEO), and we run it alongside classic SEO rather than as a separate product.

Before you hire any SEO agency, New York based or remote, ask to see three things: a recent monthly report, how they decide which pages to write, and what they changed when a client's rankings fell. The answers tell you more than any ranking screenshot.

sections.h: Personal injury and law firm SEO in New York
p: Law firms are among the most competitive searches in New York, and accuracy matters as much as rankings. We write monthly SEO content for US personal injury firms and check every statute before it is published. For New York pages that means getting details right, such as the three-year limit for most personal injury claims, the shorter window for medical malpractice, and the 90-day notice of claim usually required before suing a city agency. One wrong deadline on a page can mislead a reader and embarrass a firm.
Practice pages are built around how people actually search: by injury, by borough, by situation, such as a construction accident on a Manhattan job site or a crash on the BQE.

Grow: monthly content, outside mentions and reporting, adjusted to what the data shows.

faqs.q: How long does SEO take to work in New York?
faqs.a: Technical fixes and Google Business Profile changes tend to show first. Competitive New York searches, such as personal injury or cosmetic dentistry, take longer and need steady content and outside mentions. We agree milestones in writing and report monthly, so you can see what is moving and what is not.

faqs.q: Can you rank us in Brooklyn and Queens as well as Manhattan?
faqs.a: Yes, if you serve those areas. Local rankings depend on your real address, your Google Business Profile and pages that genuinely serve each borough. We build borough and neighborhood pages with useful local detail, not swapped place names, which Google treats as spam.

faqs.q: What is GEO and how is it different from SEO?
faqs.a: GEO is about how AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews, describe and recommend you. SEO focuses on ranking pages. They overlap heavily: clear facts, consistent listings, strong pages and outside mentions help both. We run them together and check AI answers monthly.

faqs.q: Do you work with New York law firms?
faqs.a: Yes. We write monthly SEO and content for US personal injury firms and check every statute and deadline before publishing. For New York firms we cover practice, injury and borough pages, attorney profiles, and the listings and reviews that matter for legal searches.

faqs.q: Why hire an SEO agency based in London for New York searches?
faqs.a: Because SEO results depend on the work, not the agency's address. Your rankings rely on your site, your Google Business Profile and your reputation. We bring a team that also builds websites, runs ads and makes video, which most single-service SEO agencies cannot offer, and we schedule calls in your morning.

faqs.q: How much does SEO cost in New York?
faqs.a: It depends on competition, number of locations, site health and content volume. We do not publish prices. After a 15-minute call and a quick look at your current rankings, we send a written proposal with the scope and the first three months planned.
